message.content:
An aerial view shows a dense cluster of collapsed and damaged wooden houses. The structures are primarily made of light-colored wood planks and reddish-brown corrugated metal roofing. Many buildings are reduced to splintered debris, with broken beams, planks, and tangled metal sheets scattered across the ground. Some houses remain partially standing with missing walls or caved-in roofs. Debris is piled high between the structures, covering almost all visible ground. A few green palm trees stand amidst the wreckage.

In the upper-left, white text reads "Kontroversi Rehabilitasi Ira Puspadewi H.86". In the upper-right, white text reads "Pinjaman Instan Menjerat Kawula Muda H.100". The large white word "TEMPO" is centered across the upper third. Below it, smaller white text is partially legible. In the center, large bold white letters read "GENGSI TINGGI DARURAT BENCANA". Below this, smaller white text describes President Prabowo Subianto and flood conditions in Sumatra. In the lower-right corner, a barcode, a QR code, and small text indicating a date of "8-14 DESEMBER 2024" and a price of "RP 60.000" are visible.
